leadText: Bianca (Japanese: ベル Bell) is a supporting character of the Pokémon Adventures manga series.
plainText:
Bianca (Japanese: ベル Bell) is a supporting character of the Pokémon Adventures manga series.

==Character==
Bianca is a newly starting out Pokémon Trainer along with her two friends, and . She and Cheren are well acquainted with Professor Juniper and were the ones who recommended him to be the third Unova Pokédex holder despite her having never met the boy before. She is described as a girl who goes about in her own pace and is prone to impulsive actions that can get her and those around her in trouble.

==History==
===Past===
Bianca, along with Cheren, has been friends with Black since they were small children. As the three played together, Black would eventually gain an interest in challenging the , but needed an excuse to set off on a journey. After learning about the Pokédex via a televised interview with Cedric Juniper, Bianca suggested that Black should capture a Pokémon and earn a Pokédex from Cedric. While searching on for something to catch, Bianca was attacked by a wild Rufflet, but was saved by Black with the help of a wild Munna.

=== ===
 
Bianca debuted in Choices. She and Cheren met with Professor Juniper at her laboratory to ask why the first partner Pokémon and Pokédexes that were supposed to be delivered to Black's house haven't arrived yet. They discovered that two of the first partner Pokémon had gotten into a fight with each other while the third ran off elsewhere. While Professor Juniper cleaned up the mess, Bianca took for herself and gave to Cheren, stating that it resembled him. They tracked Tepig's footprints to a nearby cliffside, where they found it and Black stuck in a tree, being attacked by a wild Pokémon. Professor Juniper decided to use the moment to see if Black was still worthy of owning a Pokédex despite the trouble he caused her. By cooperating with Tepig, Black managed to defeat the that was attacking him. With Sewaddle defeated, Black immediately left to start his journey, leaving the others behind. Later, Bianca and Cheren realized that because of Black's negligence, their Pokédexes ended up left in a puddle, causing them to malfunction.

In A Nickname for Tepig, Bianca and Cheren had a quick sparring match that ended in Bianca's loss. Professor Juniper revealed that repairing the Pokédexes would take longer than she expected. With Black having the only working Pokédex, Professor Junper told Bianca and Cheren to go find Black and tell him to take care of it. 

 
In Welcome to Striaton City!!, Bianca and Cheren found Black at the Striaton Gym. They chastised Black for leaving home without them and causing their Pokédexes to get damaged. Seeing the conversation, the Gym Leaders, Cilan, Cress, and Chili, allowed Bianca and Cheren to participate in the Gym challenge alongside Black. Together, Bianca, Cheren, and Black managed to defeat the triplet Gym Leaders and earn the . Afterward, Black apologized for his actions and gave Cheren and Bianca a Xtransceiver each so they could keep in touch. After going their separate ways, Bianca and Cheren realized they never exchanged numbers with Black, forcing them to go and find him again.

In Big City Battles, Bianca walked through the streets of Castelia City in order to find Black for his Xtransceiver number. She was knocked unconscious by a 's and had her new stolen. After learning of the situation, Black managed to track the thieves to their hideout and rescued all of the Pokémon they had stolen, including Bianca's Litwick.

In With a Little Help from My Friends, encountered Bianca playing the flute in Anville Town. Bianca confessed that she was feeling depressed because she had spent most of her journey avoiding her overprotective father, which prevented her from improving her skill in battling. To hopefully cheer her up, White showed off Bianca's musical skill to a she knew and took Bianca to Café Sonata to potentially start a career in music. Just as they arrived, Bianca and White found the place in shambles, it having been ransacked by a wild in its pursuit of a . The Guitarist revealed it was his dream to play music with Meloetta, but Vullaby's attack left his hand broken. Feeling sorry for the man, Bianca grabbed his guitar, intending to play with Meloetta in his place.

In A Lost Melody, White kept Vullaby and its allies busy while Bianca struggled to learn how to play the song on the Guitarist's sheet music. After perfecting it, she helped Meloetta remember the move , allowing it to achieve its . With its new form, Meloetta easily defeated the Vullaby horde, allowing White to capture the leader and add it to her team. Inspired the ordeal, Bianca told Professor Juniper she decided to become her assistant and give up on her journey. When asked about the newly-repaired Pokédex, Bianca decided to give it to White.

=== ===
Two years later, in The Transfer Student, Bianca was called over to the Aspertia City Trainers' School that Cheren started teaching at. She presented two Pokédexes to and , the winners of an exhibition tournament between Cheren's students. Later, Bianca talked to Cheren about his first day as a teacher. They were interrupted by a call from Drayden, who informed them of the third Legendary Dragon of the Unova region: . He noted that Team Plasma may have revived in order to obtain Kyurem for themselves.

In Pink Slip, Bianca, Fennel, Amanita, Professor Juniper, and Cedric Juniper hid in Fennel's house in Striaton City, which had been frozen by Team Plasma's flying ship, the Plasma Frigate. Fennel revealed that she discovered another dimension known as the Pokémon Dream World and hypothesized that Black may have been sent there after being sealed into the Light Stone. Hearing this, Bianca immediately decided to go to the Entralink, but Fennel admitted she already sent White there to confirm her theory. The plan proved to be a success, as White managed to find and obtain the Light Stone.

In The Final Battle, Bianca and Cedric traveled to Undella Town, which had also been frozen by the Plasma Frigate. They attempted to break the ice covering the Marine Tube's entrance to free Cheren and his class, who had been using the place as shelter. With the combined might of , , and , Bianca, Cheren, Cedric, and Benga destroyed the ice and rescued everyone. After confirming the safety of Cheren's missing students, Bianca revealed to him that Black had been freed from the Light Stone. Later, Bianca and Cheren were transported to the abandoned N's Castle. The area had been set ablaze when the Plasma Frigate crashed into it, putting the Pokémon Team Plasma left behind at risk. Bianca, Black, White, Blake, Whitley, Hugh, Cheren, Benga, and Cedric combined the might of all three stages of the Unova first partner Pokémon and unleashed a triple Water, Grass, and Fire Pledge combination attack, successfully dousing the flames.

In Epilogue, Bianca attended the Trainers' School graduation ceremony, where she watched Cheren's students graduate.

==Trivia==
She and Cheren have different first partner Pokémon to the games. In the games, Bianca has the first partner Pokémon that would be weaker to the player character (corresponding to Black in Adventures); in Adventures, she instead has the first partner Pokémon that is stronger against Black's.
